reports.title: Reports
reports.salaryNotSet: No monthly salary set for this employee — pay cannot be calculated. Set it under Employees.
reports.noAbsence: No absence — all {{days}} scheduled day(s) worked
reports.rateNote: All rates come from {{salary}} ÷ 30 days = {{dailyWage}} SAR per day. Absence is charged at that daily rate. Overtime: {{dailyWage}} ÷ 10 h = {{hourly}} SAR/h × 1.5 = {{overtime}} SAR/h = {{perMinute}} SAR per minute.
reports.inProgress: This month is still running — days not yet reached are not counted as absence.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Each branch is one shop location with its own staff. Give a branch a location and a radius, and any employee of that branch who tracks their location (via "Track My Location") is flagged for review if they're away from their own branch while clocked in — they are never automatically clocked out.
branches.locationHint: Open this page on your phone while standing at this branch, then tap "Use My Current Location". You can also leave the location blank and add it later.
branches.radiusHint: How far from the branch's center point still counts as "at this branch", in meters. 150 m suits most shops.
branches.noBranches: No branches yet. Add your first one above.
branches.confirmDelete: Delete this branch? You must move its employees to another branch first.
branches.geoNotSupported: Your browser doesn't support location services.
branches.geoError: Could not get your current location.

track.selectPrompt: Select your name to start tracking (you must already be clocked in at the kiosk)
track.notClockedIn: You're not clocked in yet. Please clock in at the kiosk first.
track.activeHint: Keep this page open while you're at work. It checks your location every couple of minutes.
track.outsideZone: You appear to be away from your branch. This has been flagged for your manager to review.
track.geoNotSupported: Your browser doesn't support location services.
